name: linear
description: Start (and shepherd) work on a Linear ticket end-to-end — fetch the issue via the Linear MCP, classify quick-fix vs spec-driven, create an isolated worktree using Linear's canonical branchName, rename the session after the ticket, move the ticket to In Progress, and chain into the right follow-up skill (OpenSpec or superpowers). Also advances tickets to In Review on PR open and Done on merge via a persisted worktree sentinel.
